verdict.rationale: There are no first-party docs on Warp's SSH integration; the only signs of it are indirect community reports. One user says Warp feels like magic when SSHing into a home server; another notes SSH issues on one machine that they work around with `command ssh`, which implies Warp wraps ssh. A third reports code indexing and the file explorer failing over SSH. The agent CLI working over SSH (warp-docs-59, warp-docs-23) is a separate capability and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented SSH integration, terminfo propagation, remote shell-integration setup, config carry-over, and reliable hands-on corroboration.
